core_scientific_findings.summary: The frozen dev_mIoU_phenomena metric correctly evaluates an unweighted arithmetic macro average over all 11 phenomenon classes present on DEV. Audit confirms that exactly 11 phenomenon classes have positive ground-truth support on DEV (zero classes have zero GT pixels), meaning the effective macro denominator is always exactly 11. However, the physical support structure is heavily concentrated: 4 dominant classes comprise 65.81% of DEV valid pixels, 4 intermediate classes comprise 8.56%, and 3 ultra-sparse classes comprise only 0.44%. The observed ~0.049 score is a valid macro-class performance measure with substantial support sensitivity. Because macro averaging weights each class equally, low-IoU classes contribute equally at the class level despite much smaller pixel support, so the headline macro score is substantially lower than a pixel-weighted descriptive summary (0.16158). Furthermore, single-parent classes (OF, RF) introduce descriptive evaluation-subset sensitivity: removing either parent changes the evaluation subset such that the class has 0 GT pixels, causing the frozen metric to exclude it from the denominator and yielding a higher subset score (+0.004 to +0.0105) over fewer classes, which is not directly comparable to the full-DEV benchmark.

complete_calculation_trace.name: INPUT_PREDICTION_DECISION_RULE
complete_calculation_trace.description: Standard deterministic pixel-wise multiclass argmax across all 12 channels (0..11) at each pixel.

complete_calculation_trace.name: TARGET_FILTERING_AND_IGNORING
complete_calculation_trace.description: Pixels marked with ignore_index=-100 (left-swath border padding where validity_mask==False and excluded source classes 3, 9, 14) are excluded prior to confusion matrix accumulation.

complete_calculation_trace.name: 12x12_CONFUSION_MATRIX_ACCUMULATION
complete_calculation_trace.description: True classes form rows (0..11), predicted classes form columns (0..11). Accumulated across all 40 DEV batches.

complete_calculation_trace.name: TRUE_POSITIVE_AND_UNION_EXTRACTION
complete_calculation_trace.semantics: tp = diag(cm); fp = col_sum - tp; fn = row_sum - tp; gt = tp + fn; union = gt + fp
complete_calculation_trace.description: Per-class ground truth count is gt[c] = tp[c] + fn[c]. Per-class predicted count is pred[c] = tp[c] + fp[c]. Union is union[c] = gt[c] + pred[c] - tp[c].

complete_calculation_trace.name: ABSENT_CLASS_AND_ZERO_UNION_DISPATCH
complete_calculation_trace.semantics: if gt[c] > 0: iou = tp[c] / union[c] if union[c] > 0 else 0.0; else: iou = None
complete_calculation_trace.description: If a class has gt[c] == 0 (zero ground truth pixels on DEV), it is assigned iou = None. If gt[c] > 0 and union[c] > 0, iou = tp[c] / union[c]. If gt[c] > 0 and union[c] == 0 (degenerate), iou = 0.0.

complete_calculation_trace.name: PHENOMENA_FILTERING_AND_MACRO_AVERAGE
complete_calculation_trace.semantics: if c > 0 and gt[c] > 0: present_classes_phenomena.append(iou); miou_phenomena = np.mean(present_classes_phenomena)
complete_calculation_trace.description: Background class 0 is excluded from phenomena metric (c > 0). Classes with gt[c] == 0 are omitted from the list. The macro mean averages strictly over present phenomenon classes.

exact_semantic_behaviors.background_handling: Dense class 0 (BG) is accumulated in confusion matrix and evaluated for mIoU_all, but strictly excluded from dev_mIoU_phenomena denominator and numerator.
exact_semantic_behaviors.ignore_index_behavior: Pixels with target == -100 are filtered out completely; they contribute zero to TP, FP, FN, or union for any class.

absent_class_behavior.case_a_absent_gt_absent_pred: gt[c] == 0, pred[c] == 0 -> iou[c] = None, excluded from macro denominator.
absent_class_behavior.case_b_absent_gt_present_pred: gt[c] == 0, pred[c] > 0 -> iou[c] = None, excluded from macro denominator (false positives are not penalized in class c IoU, though they hurt precision of true classes).
absent_class_behavior.case_c_present_gt_absent_pred: gt[c] > 0, pred[c] == 0 -> tp[c] = 0, union[c] = gt[c] -> iou[c] = 0.0, included in macro denominator (penalized as 0.0).
absent_class_behavior.case_d_present_gt_present_pred: gt[c] > 0, pred[c] > 0 -> iou[c] = tp[c] / union[c], included in macro denominator.

exact_semantic_behaviors.zero_union_behavior: If union[c] == 0, if gt[c] == 0 returns None; if gt[c] > 0 returns 0.0.
exact_semantic_behaviors.nan_behavior: No NaNs are propagated; absent classes evaluate to None and are excluded from the array passed to np.mean().
exact_semantic_behaviors.macro_average_denominator_rule: Denominator equals count of phenomenon classes (1..11) where gt[c] > 0 on DEV.

ops02_dev_reality_verdict.finding: Auditing both the dataset manifest and the physical GeoTIFF ground truth masks confirms that all 11 phenomenon classes have positive ground-truth support in OPS-02 DEV (gt[c] > 0). Consequently, no phenomenon class is dropped by the absent-class filter on OPS-02 DEV. All 11 classes produce numeric values (between 0.0 and 1.0) and the macro average denominator is exactly 11 in every evaluated run.

decision_logic.description: The frozen primary metric remains valid for its intended macro-class objective, but its estimate is materially sensitive to uneven physical support and sparse class representation in the current DEV partition. This limits representativeness and the stability of class-level interpretation; it does not establish that the metric is mathematically invalid.
decision_logic.stop_action: Do not modify the frozen benchmark metric. Preserve dev_mIoU_phenomena as the official gate. Maintain support-stratified secondary reporting framework.
decision_logic.recommended_next_step: Proceed to DIAG-02-SAMPLER-EXPOSURE-SCHEDULE-AUDIT under the approved C22-E/F diagnostic roadmap.

reclassification_history.reason: Calibrated normative framing: equal class weighting is an intentional macro metric property. The metric is support-sensitive, not mathematically invalid or distorted. Corrected Rank-2 identity to DIAG-02-SAMPLER-EXPOSURE-SCHEDULE-AUDIT.
